mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.shop_id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status,o.business_type,o.settlement_kind,o.fulfillment_state,o.member_level_code, COALESCE(o.original_amount,o.total_amount) original_amount,o.discount_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items item WHERE item.order_id = o.id) AS itemCount
mapper.select: WITH selected_items AS ( SELECT id, order_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN #{id} ), ranked_tasks AS ( SELECT i.order_id, t.reward_kind, t.status, t.exclusion_reason, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.order_id, t.reward_kind ORDER BY FIELD(t.status, 'ATTENTION', 'WAIT_PAYMENT', 'WAIT_RECEIPT', 'WAIT_AFTERSALE', 'READY', 'APPLIED', 'EXCLUDED'), t.id) AS position_in_kind FROM selected_items i JOIN member_reward_tasks t ON t.order_item_id=i.id ), task_summary AS ( SELECT order_id, MAX(CASE WHEN reward_kind='POINTS' AND position_in_kind=1 THEN status END) AS point_status, MAX(CASE WHEN reward_kind='GROWTH' AND position_in_kind=1 THEN status END) AS growth_status, CASE WHEN COUNT(exclusion_reason)=COUNT(*) AND MIN(exclusion_reason)=MAX(exclusion_reason) THEN MIN(exclusion_reason) END AS exclusion_reason FROM ranked_tasks GROUP BY order_id ), points AS ( SELECT i.order_id, SUM(p.issued_units) AS credited, SUM(p.reversed_units) AS reversed FROM selected_items i JOIN member_point_lots p ON p.order_item_id=i.id GROUP BY i.order_id ), growth AS ( SELECT i.order_id, SUM(GREATEST(g.delta_amount,0)) AS credited, SUM(GREATEST(-g.delta_amount,0)) AS reversed FROM selected_items i JOIN member_growth_entries g ON g.order_item_id=i.id GROUP BY i.order_id ) SELECT t.order_id, t.point_status, t.growth_status, COALESCE(p.credited,0) AS credited_point_units, COALESCE(g.credited,0) AS credited_growth_amount, COALESCE(p.reversed,0) AS clawed_back_point_units, COALESCE(g.reversed,0) AS clawed_back_growth_amount, t.exclusion_reason FROM task_summary t LEFT JOIN points p ON p.order_id=t.order_id LEFT JOIN growth g ON g.order_id=t.order_id
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(pay_expires_at), #{now}) FROM orders WHERE status = 'UNPAID' AND pay_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND pay_expires_at <= #{now}
